description: This file contains utility functions and variables for the Gorilla WebSocket package, including WebSocket handshake key generation, challenge key validation, and header parsing.

methods.name: computeAcceptKey
methods.description: Computes the WebSocket accept key from a challenge key by applying SHA1 and base64 encoding.

methods.name: generateChallengeKey
methods.description: Generates a 16-byte random challenge key encoded in base64 for WebSocket handshake.

methods.name: skipSpace
methods.description: Removes leading whitespace (spaces and tabs) from a string.

methods.name: nextToken
methods.description: Extracts the next token from a string based on RFC 2616 token rules.

methods.name: nextTokenOrQuoted
methods.description: Extracts the next token or quoted string from a string.

methods.name: equalASCIIFold
methods.description: Performs ASCII case-insensitive comparison of two strings.

methods.name: tokenListContainsValue
methods.description: Checks if an HTTP header's comma-separated token list contains a specific value.

methods.name: parseExtensions
methods.description: Parses WebSocket extension headers into a list of extension parameter maps.

methods.name: isValidChallengeKey
methods.description: Validates if a challenge key string meets RFC 6455 specifications (base64-encoded 16-byte value).
